personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly functional, and fresh interface that feels as clean and organized as a newly serviced home.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Cards never sit flush to screen edge; always use md or lg outer margins. Thumb zone CTA is sticky at the bottom.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, sticky headers over scrolling content, and sticky bottom CTA containers
Apply glass over hero cards when paired with background imagery
Ensure strong readability on glass by using translucent tinting beneath
dont's: Do not apply glass to body content, form inputs, or individual list rows
Do not let background text bleed clearly through glass headers

screens.name: Client Home (Inicio)
screens.purpose: Allow customers to see their upcoming cleaning appointments or easily book a new one.

states.loading: Centered spinner with soft sage tint.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean, sparkling home with text 'Aún no tienes citas.' and a prominent 'Agendar Cita' button.
states.error: Message: 'Hubo un error al cargar tus citas' with retry button.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top taking 30% of screen height with a clean modern living room background image, vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse), and a large 'Agendar nueva limpieza' text/button on top. Below, a section titled 'Próximas Citas' listing upcoming bookings in surfaceSecondary cards. Use glassmorphism on the sticky bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Booking Flow (Agendar Cita)
screens.purpose: Step-by-step form allowing the client to select service type, choose date/time, and input their address.

states.error: Form validation errors displayed inline below inputs.

screens.layout: Clean scrollable list of inputs. Service selection using horizontal scrolling cards with images. Date picker with a horizontal strip of days. Address input fields. The primary CTA 'Continuar al Pago' must be sticky at the bottom over a glassmorphic background container, never hidden by scrolling.

screens.name: Checkout (Pago en Línea)
screens.purpose: Secure Stripe payment integration completed before the service is confirmed.

states.loading: Processing payment overlay (fullscreen translucent blur with spinner).
states.error: Payment failed toast/modal with 'Intentar de nuevo'.

screens.layout: Order summary card (surfaceSecondary) showing selected service, date, and address. Total amount highlighted prominently (xl size). Stripe payment elements (card input) below. Sticky 'Pagar ahora' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Admin Agenda (Dashboard Personal)
screens.purpose: Allow staff/admin to view all upcoming bookings and client details.

states.empty: Icon of calendar with 'No hay limpiezas agendadas para hoy'.
states.error: Failed to load agenda message with retry.

screens.layout: Horizontal date strip at the top. Vertical list of appointment cards. Each card displays time, client name, service type, and address. Primary action on each card: 'Ver Ruta' (opens Maps) using brandSecondary tinted buttons.

screens.name: Admin Login (Acceso)
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for cleaning staff and admin to access the agenda.

states.error: Invalid credentials shake animation or inline red text.

screens.layout: Minimalist centered login form on a surfaceTertiary or subtly blurred photo background. Email and Password fields. Sticky 'Ingresar' CTA.

hero_living_room.alt: Clean and modern bright living room in pastel colors

service_eco_cleaning.alt: Eco-friendly cleaning supplies in a pastel organizer

empty_state_clean_home.alt: Empty modern living room with large window

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is completely in Spanish (es-MX or es-ES). Ensure all CTA texts, placeholders, and error messages are in Spanish.
Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean' UI. The palette heavily relies on a fresh Sage/Moss green (brandPrimary) as an accent on top of off-white/sand bases. Avoid ANY blue or purple completely.

The Hero card in 'Client Home' MUST include the `hero_living_room` image as an `expo-image` background, overlaid with a vertical `expo-linear-gradient` scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse), and place the 'Agendar Limpieza' button in the bottom 30% of the card.

All primary CTAs (like 'Continuar al Pago', 'Pagar ahora') on scrollable screens MUST be sticky at the bottom in a fixed container (using KeyboardAvoidingView where applicable) so they are never hidden under the scroll.
For the Admin Agenda, ensure the 'Ver Ruta' button uses React Native's `Linking` API to open Apple Maps or Google Maps with the provided address coordinates/string.
Use Stripe elements/SDK for the 'Pago en Línea' screen checkout flow. Ensure it triggers before finalizing the booking API call.
Maintain high contrast. Form inputs should have labels above the input fields, and use `surfaceTertiary` for the input backgrounds with `md` border radius.
Research takeaway: Users expect a streamlined 3-step booking flow (Service -> Time -> Pay). Keep the calendar horizontal and visually uncluttered to prevent conflicts easily.
